---
name: tdd
description: Use when the user asks to implement a change using a test-driven development workflow.
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: true
---

Implement using Test Driven Development.

1. Start by creating the necessary models and methods without implementation.
2. Write tests. The project should build, but the tests should fail.
3. Ask the user: "Do you want me to implement this?"
